opening.argument: The video promotes OneCoin through a participation-and-returns structure: it says that “the person who bought all the coins will get a share of all these coins later,” then invites viewers to “Join the financial revolution.” It presents OneCoin as a vehicle for mobile money transfers, stating, “Each person can send money with OneCoin. You only need a mobile phone to do this.” The promotion is reinforced by an absolute safety claim that making coins, transferring money, and paying with OneCoin is “absolutely safe,” alongside a frame displaying “SAFE.” These combined claims support a token-purchase and appreciation mechanism, although the title and description leave some informational or news framing possible, and the record does not establish completed transactions, losses, or the truth of the claims.
